invariants.rationale: Regardless of which branch is taken, a new table object is returned, never null.
metaClient is dereferenced via metaClient.getTableType(), so it cannot be null at this program point.
If the table type is anything else, an exception is thrown and the method does not exit normally.
Both possible return statements instantiate the table object with the passed metaClient, so result must reference the same metaClient.
Only these two types of tables can be returned based on the switch.
